name: intro_lets_go
tags: upbeat cartoon theme song, happy pop rock, catchy, energetic, bright female and male vocals, group chorus, electric guitar, drums, 140 bpm, major key, fun, friendship
lyrics:
[verse]
Wheels are turning, engines humming,
All my friends, I hear you coming!
Big or small or fast or slow,
Together, come on, let's go!

[chorus]
Mega-Mega, MegaWheel Arena!
Never give up, we'll race forever!
Ding-ding-ding, the road is calling,
Get back up whenever you're falling!
MegaWheel... Arena!

name: outro_see_you
tags: warm gentle cartoon ending song, soft acoustic ballad, ukulele, piano, heartfelt, sweet female vocal, 88 bpm, major key, goodbye, cozy, hopeful
lyrics:
[verse]
The sun goes down, the road is quiet,
We had our race, we had our fun.
Wave goodbye, my wheels are tired,
But tomorrow's a brand new run!

[chorus]
See you soon at MegaWheel Arena,
Friends forever, near or far.
Ding-ding, goodnight, sweet dreams, my friend,
This is not the end!
